levels.name: Diagnostic Integrity
levels.purpose: Validate the diagnostics frame before trusting its output.

levels.name: Target Context
levels.purpose: Resolve target, runtime context, VCS state, paths and basic executability.

levels.name: Repository Inventory
levels.purpose: Collect bounded technology-neutral evidence about repository shape and capabilities.

levels.name: Repository Hygiene
levels.purpose: Detect repository-level integrity and hygiene hazards.

levels.name: Tooling Discovery
levels.purpose: Discover project manifests, automation surfaces and candidate tools without making them mandatory.

levels.name: Declared Validations
levels.purpose: Execute only validations explicitly declared by the local diagnostics configuration.

levels.name: Security Hygiene
levels.purpose: Perform bounded conservative hygiene checks without claiming a security audit.

levels.name: Kristal Release Model Integrity
levels.purpose: Validate rc.2 curated release surfaces, version/canonicalization identity and absence of retired per-file manifest machinery.

levels.name: Kristal Negative Release Gate
levels.purpose: Mutate critical release inputs and verify the rc.2 native release gate fails closed.

levels.name: Kristal Git Release Archive Reproducibility
levels.purpose: Build releases from temporary Git repos and test determinism, clean-tree enforcement and untracked-evidence isolation.

levels.name: Kristal Schema Negative Cases
levels.purpose: Verify required/schema-version negative mutations are rejected.

levels.name: Kristal JCS Fail-Closed
levels.purpose: Verify JCS vectors pass and tampered vectors/hashes fail.

levels.name: Kristal Conformance Coverage
levels.purpose: Separate framework-vector TCK coverage from external implementation-adapter conformance readiness.

levels.name: Kristal Strict Docs Build
levels.purpose: Run mkdocs build --strict when the declared toolchain is available.

levels.name: Kristal Retired Release Model Guard
levels.purpose: Ensure retired manifest tooling remains absent and current release/archive policy stays Git-pinned and curated.

levels.name: Kristal v5 Normative Hygiene
levels.purpose: Detect stale major-version markers and release-status ambiguity in normative v5 validation documentation.

levels.name: Kristal Schema Format Fail-Closed
levels.purpose: Verify date-time and URI format constraints are enforced fail-closed by native schema validation.

levels.name: Kristal Cross-Document Contract Mutation
levels.purpose: Mutate cross-document normative invariants and verify the release gate rejects semantic drift.

levels.name: Kristal Git Release Identity
levels.purpose: Verify VERSION/tag/commit publication state against the authoritative Git worktree.

levels.name: Kristal TCK Profile Consistency
levels.purpose: Cross-check Exchange and Runtime Pack TCK identity profiles against documentation and the native conformance gate.

levels.name: Kristal Runtime Pack Contract
levels.purpose: Verify Runtime Pack version/type/profile/tamper semantics and reject invalid core vectors.

levels.name: Kristal Signature and Trust
levels.purpose: Validate signature/trust contract surfaces and require an external crypto adapter for executable security conformance.

baseline.description: Universal read-oriented diagnostics with no target command execution.

deep.description: Maximum local Kristal validation: native gates, adversarial mutations, Git/archive reproducibility, TCK/profile coherence, Runtime Pack contracts and signature/trust readiness.
